items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: A fellow by the name of Wallace. Wallace gave me that banjo.

ctx.x: What kind of banjo did you have when you first started?

I had a practice. A fellow by the name of Wallace. Wallace gave me that banjo. A five string banjo. And I started to play it and I bought me a book. And I started to play in it. And the fellow knocked on my door and said, Hey man, I need a banjo player for tonight. I said, I don't play no banjo. He said, Oh yeah, you do. I said, I don't. So, he said, Let me see that banjo you got. I said, I showed it to him. He said, Man, come on and play. Make this little change. So, after I played him, I went to World Islands…
They said you played with Johnny Sincere, but he played, you mean in the same band?
